observation_contract: Source corpus, controller root, operator, administrator and claimed locator are recorded
Exactly three signed observation envelopes bind the AETHER-212 incident SHA-256 and common source-corpus ancestry
Each witness public key is compared with a separately provisioned SHA-256 pin and ECDSA P-256 signature verified
Declared witness roots, operators, administrators, hosts and key fingerprints must be mutually distinct and separate from the source
Reused witness identity, receipt reference, missing evidence hash and an unresolved incident anomaly fail closed
Missing alleged independent enrollment or receipt retention fails documentary admission
limits: Different labels or signatures do not authenticate real-world independent control
GitHub and 0root.ai mirrors of one owned corpus are one ancestry, not independent witnesses
Caller-provided independently_enrolled and receipt_retention_verified booleans are assertions, not external proof
The verifier is a pure read-only evaluation and does not fetch or authenticate remote receipts
No original physical acquisition, independent authenticated remote witness, lock reclamation, recovery or operational ACT
Rust compilation, tests, GitHub Actions execution and live Pages deployment have not been verified
